deadline.value: Graduate School deadline is January 15, 2027; the department says it has no fixed deadline but advises applying by January 1 (international applicants) to be considered for funding and Graduate Council Fellowships.
deadline.quote: Chemistry PhD Doctorate Fall 2027 1278 January 15, 2027 January 15, 2027

also.quote: it can be to your advantage to apply by January 15 (January 1 for international applicants) if you wish to begin your studies in the fall.

gre_general.value: The GRE is no longer required.
gre_general.quote: Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores are no longer required.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

supervisor.value: Students are admitted by committee and usually do lab rotations before choosing a thesis lab; rotations are optional if you already have an advisor's commitment.
supervisor.quote: Our rotation program is designed to give PhD students experience in multiple research labs before deciding which lab they would like to do their PhD thesis in.

funding.value: Support comes through teaching and research assistantships and fellowships; the stated PhD stipend is $38,000 a year plus tuition scholarship and subsidized health insurance. The department notes that admission with financial support requires TOEFL 90 with speaking 18 (old scale).
funding.quote: Support is provided through teaching and research assistantships and industrial, university and departmental fellowships. | The current Ph.D. student stipend is $38,000 a year (plus subsidized health insurance and a full tuition scholarship).

entry_route.value: Applicants submit transcripts of undergraduate and, if applicable, graduate work, so both bachelor's and master's holders apply.
entry_route.quote: Two sets of official transcripts of undergraduate and (if applicable) graduate course work

notes: The department FAQ says the application fee cannot be waived, while another department page says domestic students pay no fee; the university record's fee rules are not overridden. The funding-eligibility TOEFL figure on the department page (90 with speaking 18) predates the January 2026 score-scale change.
